muse_spark_1.3/001: The strategy is deep tactical search adapted to Kalah rules with extra moves, captures and game-end collection. Moves are applied on a 13-pit circle skipping the opponent store, with capture when the last seed makes a house go from 0 to 1. Search is perspective-relative negamax: extra moves keep the same player, otherwise roles swap with negation. Terminal nodes score exact final store difference after collecting remaining seeds. Non-terminal leaves use store difference plus adaptive pit difference that grows to 1 as stores fill plus small mobility bonus. Move ordering tries extra moves then captures then large sowings, alpha-beta pruning, iterative deepening under ~0.9s, keeping the best complete depth on timeout, guaranteeing a legal move.

Search keeps absolute my/opp stores and a turn flag, does not decrement depth on extra moves, orders children by extra, capture/store gain and terminal wins, uses transposition table and iterative deepening under a time deadline with safe fallback to a greedy legal move.
